# bko-holt load plan for layout.json
# Source: host-1, Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, UEFI boot with grub, dumped 2026-11-08T02:11:02Z
#
# Disks:
#   vda (16 GiB) -> /dev/sdq

# ---- partition ----
# vda -> /dev/sdq: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vda1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=1562624 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=1564672 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=5232640 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda3: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=5234688 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=9426944 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda4: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=9428992 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=33550336 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: gpt
label-id: bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512
table-length: 128
first-lba: 34
last-lba: 33554398

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=1562624, type=C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
/dev/sdq2 : start=1564672, size=3670016, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003
/dev/sdq3 : start=5234688, size=4194304, type=0657FD6D-A4AB-43C4-84E5-0933C84B4F4F, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
/dev/sdq4 : start=9428992, size=24123392, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006
EOF
udevadm settle

# ---- assemble ----
# ZFS pool bpool, with the source's feature flags only
zpool create -f -d -o cachefile=none -o ashift=12 -o autotrim=on -o feature@async_destroy=enabled -o feature@empty_bpobj=enabled -o feature@lz4_compress=enabled -o feature@spacemap_histogram=enabled -o feature@enabled_txg=enabled -o feature@hole_birth=enabled -o feature@extensible_dataset=enabled -o feature@embedded_data=enabled -o feature@bookmarks=enabled -o feature@filesystem_limits=enabled -o feature@large_blocks=enabled -O mountpoint=/boot -O compression=lz4 -O devices=off -O canmount=off -O xattr=sa -O sync=standard -O acltype=posix -O relatime=on -O normalization=formD -O utf8only=on -R /mnt/bko-target bpool /dev/sdq2
# the source pool's GUID (vdev GUIDs can't be kept)
zpool reguid -g 1000000000000000001 bpool
# mount mounts every dataset in order
sh -c '[ "$(zfs get -H -o value mounted bpool)" != yes ] || zfs unmount bpool'
# ZFS pool rpool, with the source's feature flags only
zpool create -f -d -o cachefile=none -o ashift=12 -o autotrim=on -o feature@async_destroy=enabled -o feature@empty_bpobj=enabled -o feature@lz4_compress=enabled -o feature@multi_vdev_crash_dump=enabled -o feature@spacemap_histogram=enabled -o feature@enabled_txg=enabled -o feature@hole_birth=enabled -o feature@extensible_dataset=enabled -o feature@embedded_data=enabled -o feature@bookmarks=enabled -o feature@filesystem_limits=enabled -o feature@large_blocks=enabled -o feature@large_dnode=enabled -o feature@sha512=enabled -o feature@skein=enabled -o feature@edonr=enabled -o feature@userobj_accounting=enabled -o feature@encryption=enabled -o feature@project_quota=enabled -o feature@device_removal=enabled -o feature@obsolete_counts=enabled -o feature@zpool_checkpoint=enabled -o feature@spacemap_v2=enabled -o feature@allocation_classes=enabled -o feature@resilver_defer=enabled -o feature@bookmark_v2=enabled -o feature@redaction_bookmarks=enabled -o feature@redacted_datasets=enabled -o feature@bookmark_written=enabled -o feature@log_spacemap=enabled -o feature@livelist=enabled -o feature@device_rebuild=enabled -o feature@zstd_compress=enabled -o feature@draid=enabled -o feature@zilsaxattr=enabled -o feature@head_errlog=enabled -o feature@blake3=enabled -o feature@block_cloning=enabled -o feature@vdev_zaps_v2=enabled -o feature@redaction_list_spill=enabled -o feature@raidz_expansion=enabled -o feature@fast_dedup=enabled -o feature@longname=enabled -o feature@large_microzap=enabled -o feature@dynamic_gang_header=enabled -o feature@block_cloning_endian=enabled -o feature@physical_rewrite=enabled -O mountpoint=/ -O compression=lz4 -O devices=off -O canmount=off -O xattr=sa -O sync=standard -O dnodesize=auto -O acltype=posix -O relatime=on -O normalization=formD -O utf8only=on -R /mnt/bko-target rpool /dev/sdq4
# the source pool's GUID (vdev GUIDs can't be kept)
zpool reguid -g 1000000000000000004 rpool
# mount mounts every dataset in order
sh -c '[ "$(zfs get -H -o value mounted rpool)" != yes ] || zfs unmount rpool'

# ---- format ----
# vda1: vfat
mkfs.fat -F 32 -i BC000001 -S 512 -s 8 -f 2 -R 32 -h 2048 -M 0xf8 /dev/sdq1
# check: /dev/sdq1 is vfat with the source's FAT size, sector and cluster size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# vda3: swap
mkswap -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005 --pagesize 4096 /dev/sdq3
# check: /dev/sdq3 is swap with the source's UUID, label and page size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=none -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on bpool/BOOT
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=/boot -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on bpool/BOOT/ubuntu_atq8qv
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=none -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=/ -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/srv
zfs create -u -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/usr
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/usr/local
zfs create -u -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/games
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib/AccountsService
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib/NetworkManager
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib/apt
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib/dpkg
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/log
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/mail
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/snap
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/spool
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/www
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=none -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/USERDATA
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=/home -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/USERDATA/home_4s2xc1
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=/root -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/USERDATA/root_4s2xc1

# ---- mount ----
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv
zfs mount bpool/BOOT/ubuntu_atq8qv
zfs mount rpool/USERDATA/home_4s2xc1
zfs mount rpool/USERDATA/root_4s2xc1
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/srv
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/boot/efi
mount -t vfat -o defaults /dev/sdq1 /mnt/bko-target/boot/efi
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/usr/local
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/games
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/log
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/mail
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/snap
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/spool
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/www
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib/AccountsService
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib/NetworkManager
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib/apt
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_atq8qv/var/lib/dpkg

# ---- restore ----
# snapshot latest of /srv/bko-repo, with BackOtter's restore flags
RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id latest /mnt/bko-target
# the atimes the restore set, for boot to put back after its reads
sh -c 'mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before'

# ---- boot ----
# refuses to start unless /mnt/bko-target/etc/fstab is the restored system's (its / matches the layout's)
# the restored system's zpool.cache names the new pool
zpool set cachefile=/mnt/bko-target/etc/zfs/zpool.cache bpool
# the restored system's zpool.cache names the new pool
zpool set cachefile=/mnt/bko-target/etc/zfs/zpool.cache rpool
# / with the source's atime options (rw,nodev,relatime), for host-only dracut's rootflags=
mount -o remount,atime,relatime /mnt/bko-target
# the restored atimes (the restore stage lists them), to put back after this stage's reads
sh -c '[ -s /run/bko-holt/atimes.before ] || { mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before; }'
# the restored LVM devices file, kept
sh -c 'rm -rf /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices; [ ! -d /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices ] || { cp -a /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices && touch -r /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices.parent; }'
mount --rbind --make-rslave /dev /mnt/bko-target/dev
mount --rbind --make-rslave /proc /mnt/bko-target/proc
mount --rbind --make-rslave /sys /mnt/bko-target/sys
mount --rbind --make-rslave /run /mnt/bko-target/run
chroot /mnt/bko-target sh -c 'n=0; for k in /lib/modules/*; do [ -d "$k/kernel" ] || continue; l=$(lsinitrd -k "${k##*/}" 2>/dev/null); m=; for p in $(printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$l" | sed -n '\''s|^.* \(\(usr/\)*lib/modules/[^ ]*\.ko[.a-z0-9]*\)$|\1|p'\''); do [ -e "/$p" ] && b=${p##*/} && m="$m ${b%%.ko*}"; done; a=; f=; if printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$l" | sed -n '\''/^dracut modules:$/,/^=/p'\'' | grep -qx resume; then a=resume; r=$(lsinitrd -k "${k##*/}" -f etc/cmdline.d/95resume.conf 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$r" ] || { f=$(mktemp) && printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$r" > "$f"; } || exit; fi; dracut --force --kver "${k##*/}" ${m:+--add-drivers "$m"} ${a:+--add "$a"} ${f:+--include "$f" /etc/cmdline.d/95resume.conf}; s=$?; [ -z "$f" ] || rm -f "$f"; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || exit "$s"; n=$((n + 1)); done; [ "$n" -gt 0 ]'
chroot /mnt/bko-target grub-install --target=x86_64-efi --efi-directory=/boot/efi --bootloader-id=ubuntu --no-nvram
# os-prober off: it would list the rescue system's disks
sh -c '[ ! -e /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/os-prober ] || mount --bind /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/true /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/os-prober'
chroot /mnt/bko-target env LANG=en_US.UTF-8 update-grub
sh -c '! grep -q '\'' /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/os-prober '\'' /proc/self/mountinfo || umount /mnt/bko-target/usr/bin/os-prober'
# NVRAM's entries for this partition and loader, from an earlier restore here, deleted
bko-holt efi-dedupe /dev/sdq 1 '\EFI\ubuntu\shimx64.efi'
efibootmgr --quiet --create --disk /dev/sdq --part 1 --label Ubuntu --loader '\EFI\ubuntu\shimx64.efi'
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/var/log/bko-holt
# this restore's log, on the restored system
cp -a /run/bko-holt/log/. /mnt/bko-target/var/log/bko-holt/
# SELinux labels for the files the boot stage wrote
chroot /mnt/bko-target sh -c '[ -f /etc/selinux/config ] || exit 0; . /etc/selinux/config; [ "${SELINUX:-disabled}" != disabled ] || exit 0; f=/etc/selinux/${SELINUXTYPE:-targeted}/contexts/files/file_contexts; [ ! -f "$f" ] || ! command -v setfiles >/dev/null || { [ ! -d /etc/kernel ] || set -- /etc/kernel; setfiles "$f" /boot /var/log/bko-holt "$@"; }'
# SELinux labels for the mount points load made, which the mounts hide from the restore
chroot /mnt/bko-target sh -c '[ -f /etc/selinux/config ] || exit 0; . /etc/selinux/config; [ "${SELINUX:-disabled}" != disabled ] || exit 0; f=/etc/selinux/${SELINUXTYPE:-targeted}/contexts/files/file_contexts; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v setfiles >/dev/null || exit 0; r=/run/bko-holt/mount-points; mkdir -p "$r" && mount --bind / "$r" || exit 1; setfiles -r "$r" "$f" "$r"/boot "$r"/home "$r"/root "$r"/srv "$r"/usr/local "$r"/var/games "$r"/var/lib "$r"/var/log "$r"/var/mail "$r"/var/snap "$r"/var/spool "$r"/var/www; s=$?; umount "$r"; [ $s = 0 ] || exit $s; mkdir -p "$r"/boot && mount --bind /boot "$r"/boot || exit 1; setfiles -r "$r" "$f" "$r"/boot/efi; s=$?; umount "$r"/boot; [ $s = 0 ] || exit $s; mkdir -p "$r"/var/lib && mount --bind /var/lib "$r"/var/lib || exit 1; setfiles -r "$r" "$f" "$r"/var/lib/AccountsService "$r"/var/lib/NetworkManager "$r"/var/lib/apt "$r"/var/lib/dpkg; s=$?; umount "$r"/var/lib; [ $s = 0 ] || exit $s'
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target/run
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target/sys
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target/proc
umount --recursive /mnt/bko-target/dev
# the restored LVM devices file, put back
